definitions.explanation: a farming tool with a flat blade on a long handle, used for digging, weeding, and cultivating soil

examples.japanese: {鍬|くわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧。
examples.english: To till the field with a hoe.

examples.japanese: {鍬|くわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧。
examples.english: To raise the hoe and dig into the soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍬|くわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather uses a hoe to grow vegetables.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍬|くわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧ (to cultivate with a hoe)
- {鍬|くわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧/⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to swing/raise a hoe)
- {鍬|くわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to break ground; also, figuratively, to start tackling a problem)

TYPES:
- {平鍬|ひらぐわ} (flat-bladed hoe)
- {備中鍬|びっちゅうぐわ} (hoe with three or four prongs, for heavy soil)
- {唐鍬|とうぐわ} (heavy digging hoe)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese {鍬|くわ} is swung and pulled toward the body to turn over soil, the basic tool of traditional field work. At a groundbreaking ceremony ({鍬入|くわい}れ{式|しき}) officials make the first ceremonial cut with one.
